title: Australian Dollar Outlook: Fed and CPI to Test AUD/USD Recovery
summary: AUD/USD faces a pivotal week as the Federal Reserve meeting and Australia’s quarterly CPI report will likely decide whether the recent three-week AUD recovery continues. Market expectations around RBA hikes, US dollar direction, and renewed Middle East tensions could either extend the rally or push the pair lower.
content:
From forex.com

AUD/USD enters a pivotal week with the Federal Reserve meeting and Australia's quarterly CPI set to drive the next major move. While the Australian dollar has recovered over the past three weeks, expectations for another RBA rate hike, renewed Middle East tensions and the outlook for the US dollar could determine whether the rally extends or begins to fade.

The Federal Reserve meeting is likely to be the primary driver for AUD/USD this week, with any shift in the Fed's guidance set to influence the US dollar broadly. If the Fed signals a more dovish path or downshifts the pace of future hikes, the US dollar could weaken and provide tailwinds for risk-linked currencies such as the Australian dollar. Conversely, firmer-than-expected Fed guidance could support the dollar and weigh on AUD/USD.

Australia's quarterly CPI report is the key domestic event, carrying the potential to reshape expectations for the Reserve Bank of Australia. A higher-than-expected inflation print could reinforce bets on further RBA tightening and underpin the AUD, while a softer reading may cool rate expectations and pressure the currency.

Other risk factors should not be ignored. Renewed tensions in the Middle East have the potential to increase risk aversion and boost demand for safe-haven assets, which would likely support the US dollar at the expense of the AUD. Global risk sentiment, commodity prices and broader macro data releases this week will all contribute to the pair's intraday and medium-term dynamics.

Technically, the AUD has clawed back recent losses over the past three weeks, but momentum and follow-through are necessary for a sustained recovery. Traders will be watching how the pair reacts around key technical levels and how positioning adjusts ahead of the Fed decision and the CPI print. Market participants should prepare for heightened volatility and be ready to reassess positions once the two headline events are digested.

This outlook reflects near-term drivers and scenarios for AUD/USD; developments in central bank communications, macro prints and geopolitical developments will determine the next leg of the move.
